martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, not great for running today with the heat, but perfect swimming weather - 18:00–20:00 looks ideal with calm winds and a comfortable 25°C. Surprise Britt with a swim when they get home, you've both earned it after a long day. The water's waiting, and so is a well-deserved drink afterwards.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, great swimming conditions today, especially around 18:00–20:00 when it's warm and calm. Not the best for running, but who needs that when you can cool off in the water? Maybe surprise Martha with a swim when she gets home from work.
